integrity: Includes complete mathematical proof, reproducible Python checks and outputs. Computational checks corroborate finite instances, not all-size truth.
scientific_limitations: Only \(k\ge2\) and \(n\ge3k-1\). Orbit recovery in a given graph is not identification of the graph by \(C^2\) against arbitrary graphs. No independent priority guarantee; round depth sharp in an example but exact optimal depth for every parameter is not classified.
title: Three rounds of colour refinement recover anchored Kneser orbits
